name: Batch Information 2
definition: Set of elements used to identify the underlying batches.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the sending party, to unambiguously identify the batch of transactions.

PaymentInformationIdentification.name: Payment Information Identification
PaymentInformationIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by a sending party, to unambiguously identify the payment information group within the message.

NumberOfTransactions.name: Number Of Transactions
NumberOfTransactions.definition: Number of individual transactions included in the batch.

TotalAmount.name: Total Amount
TotalAmount.definition: Total amount of money reported in the batch entry.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the batch entry is a credit or a debit entry.
